# MLSDev

> Award-winning software development company delivering custom web and mobile applications, dedicated development teams, and specialized services for SMBs and enterprises since 2009.

MLSDev is a full-service software development agency with 15+ years of experience building scalable solutions across healthcare, fintech, ecommerce, and on-demand industries. The company specializes in offshore development teams, staff augmentation, and comprehensive digital product development with offices spanning Ukraine, USA, and Europe.

## Key Topics

- Custom Software Development
- Mobile App Development (iOS/Android)
- Web Development
- Dedicated Development Teams
- IT Staff Augmentation
- UI/UX Design
- Software Testing & QA
- DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure
- Healthcare Software (HIPAA/GDPR)
- MVP Development
- Ruby on Rails
- Node.js
- AWS/Azure/Google Cloud
- Business Analysis
- Team Extension

## Core Services

- [Custom Software Development](https://mlsdev.com/services/custom-software-development): Scalable and efficient custom software solutions tailored to business needs with 15+ years of expertise.
- [Web Development Services](https://mlsdev.com/services/web-development): Full-stack web development with modern technologies and dedicated team support.
- [Mobile App Development](https://mlsdev.com/services/mobile-app-development): iOS and Android app development for enterprises including McDonald's and goPuff.
- [Dedicated Development Team](https://mlsdev.com/services/dedicated-development-team): Hire dedicated teams in Ukraine with 98% satisfaction rate and zero recruiting fees.
- [IT Staff Augmentation](https://mlsdev.com/services/it-staff-augmentation): Remote specialists from Ukraine, USA, Europe, and GCC with up to 60% cost savings.

## Specialized Services

- [UI/UX Design Services](https://mlsdev.com/services/ui-ux-design): Result-driven design for web and mobile apps including branding and UX consulting.
- [Software Testing & QA](https://mlsdev.com/services/software-testing): Comprehensive QA outsourcing for web and mobile applications on iOS and Android platforms.
- [DevOps Services](https://mlsdev.com/services/devops): Cloud infrastructure management with AWS, Azure, Google Cloud and CI/CD automation.
- [Business Analysis](https://mlsdev.com/services/business-analysis): Strategic analysis for MVP development, market research, and digital transformation.

## Industry Solutions

- [Healthcare App Development](https://mlsdev.com/healthcare-app-developers): HIPAA, GDPR, and IEC 62304 compliant medical software solutions.
- [Industry-Specific Solutions](https://mlsdev.com/software-development-solutions): Specialized solutions for healthcare, fintech, ecommerce, on-demand, and social network platforms.
